examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The facts band of a resource detail page: an ID with its copy button, a status, the creation date, a region and a linked domain, in one column.

examples.name: Columns
examples.summary: The same facts at 2, 3 and 4 columns. Below md every grid collapses to one column, and 3 or 4 columns fall back to two at md.

examples.name: Groups
examples.summary: Facts split into titled columns, one group per column. The Region key carries an info hint, and the custom certificate has no value, so it shows the empty-value marker.

examples.name: Loading
examples.summary: While the data loads, every value becomes a skeleton and the labels stay in place, so the layout does not jump when the values arrive.

examples.name: Split
examples.summary: A subscription plan card with `variant="split"`: each label at the start and its value at the end of one row, the way a summary card reads. The payment method is not set, so it shows the empty-value marker.

examples.name: Markdown
examples.summary: The same facts written in a docs page: `DocMarkdown` turns a `<KeyValueList>` tag with `<KeyValueListItem label="…">` tags inside into a real `KeyValueList`. Each value is the text between the item tags, with inline Markdown (`**bold**`, `` `code` ``, links); an empty item shows the empty-value marker.

examples.name: Page JSON
examples.summary: The same facts in the marketing site's page JSON: `KeyValueList` is a scene, so a band places it by name in its `scene` slot (here `console-showcase-section` with `variant: "diagram"`). Its items are the scene's `children`, and each item's value is a text child.
